source: Library of Congress, Sanborn Fire Insurance Map, St. Louis Vol. 12 (1938, revised to 1950), sheet 57, image 04858_12_1950-0057
labeled_by: AI-assisted draft from the 1938 key: each site compared with the 1950 scan side by side, 2026-10-19
scope: Industrial, fuel, tank and vehicle-service uses, plus stores and warehouses for paint, hardware or building materials, plus every G.T. symbol. Excludes dwellings, general stores and flats, offices, clinics, banks, post offices, general/grocery/furniture/merchandise storage, and auto houses (A) with no other use. Groups (a field of tanks) are one entry.

definitions.gasoline_tank_count: Number of tanks the map labels as gasoline: G.T. / G.T.S. symbols, 'GASOL. STGE. TKS.', or a labeled gasoline tank. 0 means none drawn.
definitions.other_tanks: Tanks that are not labeled gasoline (water, grain, iron, fuel oil, etc.).
definitions.map_notes: Only what is printed on the sheet.
definitions.interpretation: Inference, not a map fact; never scored.

sheet_layout: S Broadway on the left edge (E Robert at top). Vulcan St, Reilly Av, Polk St and Van Buren St run top to bottom; the M.P. R.R. tracks cut diagonally; Levee St and the Mississippi River at top right.
out_of_scope_seen: LIBERTY FOUNDRY CO. AUTO PARKING with garage (A, 6 cars), 7528 Vulcan St
Railroad tracks and Levee St (infrastructure, no building)

buildings.label: FILL'G STA.
buildings.map_notes: Corner of E Robert. 16 ft. 3 G.T.S. plus one iron gasoline tank on the ground (IR. GASOL. TK. ON GRD), drawn as a circle north of the building. | 1950 G.T. count checked on the full-resolution 1950 scan: 3

buildings.label: IR. TANKS NOT USED
buildings.map_notes: 4 iron tanks in a row beside the rail tracks, labeled IR. TANKS NOT USED. No building; contents not stated.
buildings.interpretation: Unused iron tanks next to the tracks may have held petroleum; not documented on the map.

buildings.label: COAL YARD
buildings.map_notes: Open coal yard with a 1-story frame office.

buildings.label: WESTERN FOUNDRY & SASH WEIGHT CO.
buildings.use: iron foundry and sash weight works
buildings.construction: brick (cupola house fireproof; charging floor frame)
buildings.map_notes: Office at 7514-7516, factory building (K) at 7518; works run back to Water St. 2 cupolas in a fireproof house built 1916 (3 stories, 38 ft) with a frame charging floor. Two foundry buildings (C, E), earth floors. Finished products warehouse (D). Scrap iron yard, flask yard, flask warehouse, sand house, oven (not used), carpenter shop. Watchman with clock. Heat: steam & stoves. Power: electric. Spark arresters on cupolas.
buildings.interpretation: Foundry sand, slag and metals possible.
needs_human_check: still on the 1950 map? Not located on the crops.

buildings.label: LIBERTY FOUNDRY CO. MFRS. OF WARM AIR FURNS. & GREY IRON CASTINGS
buildings.construction: brick (moulding room concrete; transformer house fireproof)
buildings.map_notes: Runs from E Steins along Reilly Av. Foundries (2, 6, 11), 2 cupolas (iron-clad 2nd floor), moulding room, 2 brick core ovens, sand house, rattlers, finishing, assembling, machine shops, pattern warehouse, iron dust house, transformer house (fireproof, built 1935). Watchman with clock. Heat: hot air in factory, stoves in office. Power: electric. City water.
buildings.interpretation: Foundry sand, slag and metals possible; transformer house is a PCB screening concern, not documented on the map.
needs_human_check: still on the 1950 map? Not located on the crops.

buildings.map_notes: Two finished products warehouses, 13 and 14 ft, with a flask yard behind.

buildings.map_notes: Small concrete structure, 30 ft, at the southeast corner of the block near Polk St. Labeled not used.
buildings.interpretation: Former lime kiln: possible ash and lime residue; not documented on the map.

buildings.label: COAL YARD

buildings.label: POND (WATER FILLED QUARRY)
buildings.map_notes: Pond labeled 'water filled quarry' between Polk St and the tracks. Stone type not stated.
buildings.interpretation: Old quarries were often later filled; any fill material is unknown.

buildings.label: LOWELL BLEACHERY INC. FABRIC BLEACHERY & DYE WORKS
buildings.construction: brick (one section concrete; water tower fireproof)
buildings.map_notes: Runs from Polk St to Van Buren St. Bleach house (3 stories + basement), finishing building, dyeing & starching, machine shop, boiler room, raw material & products warehouses (sections 1-3), finished products, dust house, office. Watchman with clock. Heat: steam. Power: electric. Fuel: coal. 40,000 gal wooden gravity tank on steel frame, 33 ft above roof; hydrants and hose; city water. Mutual risk.
buildings.interpretation: Bleaching and dye chemicals possible; not documented on the map.

verification.method: Drafted from the human-verified 1938 key. Sites marked needs_human_check could not be confirmed; sites new since 1938 are NOT included yet (sweep the 1950 sheet for them before marking verified).
